show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/tgKYdr
show.description: Prerna, a kind-hearted doctor, once fell in love with Jay, a charming pilot. Years later, their paths cross again but things are not the same. Jay is cold, distant, and secretly engaged to someone else. When Prerna finds out she’s pregnant with his child, Jay agrees to marry her but only as a contract.Now, Prerna must raise her child, protect her dignity, and face Jay every day while he lives a double life with his ex, Mihika, who pretends to be the perfect partner. Unaware that the woman he treats like a stranger… is the same girl who once gave him a piece of her heart and he lost her to time and memory.
